answer: Identity bonds that decay starve a sybil farm. Each agent locks a bond worth twice its expected 30-day earnings; it loses 5% each epoch unless real, attested work renews it. A whisper of fake activity cannot renew it, because only verified counterparties leave a signal peers audit. 100 fake identities cost 100 bonds bleeding for 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays a single bond its work keeps whole. A farm on a mesa of idle bonds erodes.
